rule.source: PRC-025-2 Application Guidelines, Example Calculations, Option 8a
rule.explanation: Generator bus voltage must not fall below 0.95 per unit of the high-side nominal voltage.

verdict.reason: The source text requires voltage to stay within 0.95-1.05 pu, not below 0.95 pu; the condition uses an invalid variable and misrepresents the requirement.
